title: WORDLE WIZARD DUCK
storyTitleEn: Researchers find a Wordle strategy that wins 99% of the time

storyEn: Researchers have uncovered a strategy for the popular word game Wordle that achieves a 99% winning rate. This clever approach offers a lighthearted boost for puzzle lovers looking to sharpen their daily word game routine.
storyJa: 研究者たちが、人気の単語ゲーム「Wordle」で99%の確率で勝利を収める戦略を発見しました。パズル好きな人々の毎日のゲームルーティンを楽しくサポートしてくれる、心躍る話題です。
duckEn: Quack! A 99% win rate sounds like a quacktastic puzzle strategy to me!
